Does mystock.in support AI shopping agents?

Yes: UCP profile found Yes. In ShopBot Index's crawl of 2026-10-17, mystock.in published a UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp declaring 11 capabilities including checkout, so AI shopping agents can discover it.

What this means. AI shopping agents that support the Universal Commerce Protocol can find this store's profile and see what it supports, including checkout. Whether a given assistant actually buys from it depends on that assistant.
